_meta.note: Generated by the code-style skill. Commit this file.

rust.format: nightly cargo fmt, rustfmt.toml = hard_tabs = true only; run `cargo fmt -p <crate>` before staging (editor formatter differs)
rust.imports: hoisted `use` block at file top, grouped std / external / crate; nested braces for multi-item paths; occasional inline std paths in tests
rust.comments: `//` inline, `///` doc; long prose doc comments explaining WHY, wrapped ~100 cols
rust.tests: #[cfg(test)] mod tests in-file for unit tests; live integration tests under <crate>/tests/*.rs with #[shared_test_runtime]
rust.errors: `?` with crate error enums; unwrap only in tests
rust.visibility: pub(crate) by default inside crates; pub only on the FFI/JS surface

typescript.format: prettier via filen-sdk-rs/web/.prettierrc: useTabs, tabWidth 4, printWidth 140, semi false, double quotes, trailingComma none, arrowParens avoid
typescript.comments: `//` inline; `///` used as a doc-comment marker above test functions and helpers in main.test.ts
typescript.tests: vitest browser mode (chromium then firefox), filen-sdk-rs/web/main.test.ts; default timeout 3 min × VITE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MULT (vitest.config.ts, CI sets 10); an explicit per-test timeout goes through `cap()` in vitest's options-object form `test(name, { timeout: cap(N) }, fn)` — prettier hugs `test(name, fn, N)` only for a numeric-literal N, a call expression there unhugs the whole test

subprojectOverrides.filen-sdk-rs/web: prettier config above; yaml/yml overrides to 2-space

notes: Pre-commit hook runs cargo fmt --check, taplo, sqlfluff, and a clippy battery (see CLAUDE.md)
